contract.ordering: paths, IDs, fields, and command lists are deterministic
contract.stderr: findings and usage errors are separate from stdout
contract.stdout: JSON is jsonStable with sorted object keys; text has stable headings

source.content:
# Changelog

Record only current-contract changes here: product-contract changes, significant architecture decisions, invariant changes, large reconciles, and schema or process changes. Git remains the source of truth for ordinary change history.

- Wiki established from the wiki-ssot kit.

semantics: seed files write only when absent
managed blocks replace one declared block and preserve host bytes
manifest v2 is content-addressed and records host integrations

method.changeCouplingMethod: git log --no-merges and git diff --numstat over the pinned coupling-to-baseline range
method.importExportMethod: TypeScript compiler API createProgram/checker AST; import/export declarations, including type-only clauses
method.lineDefinition: LF byte count; a final newline contributes one line
method.revisionCheckout: detached git checkout of exact revision in a disposable clone
method.writeGuard: write-producing CLI fixtures run only in disposable clones with CI/GitHub/PR variables removed

rule.candidateRule: lines > 1000 OR bytes > 65536 OR ((bytes > 30720 OR payload share > 0.1) AND responsibility count > 1) OR dispatcher lines > 250 OR repeated non-merge coupling
rule.decision: line count is supporting evidence; ownership, payload share/bytes, responsibility count, and change coupling decide

order: TE-03 after KM-07 when not activated earlier
sequencing.te03: TE-03 is currently deferred; if activated before KM ratification, finish TE-03 and regenerate KM-00
